title: Manthara's success in poisoning Kaikeyi's mind
introduction: This chapter describes Manthara's success in turning Kaikeyi's mind away from good towards evil.
closing: || इत्यार्षे स्रिमद्रामयणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्य काण्दे नवम सर्गः ||
Thus completes the ninth sarga of Ayodhya Kanda of Srimad Ramayana.

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्ता तु कैकेयी कोपेन ज्वलितानना |
दीर्घमुष्टम् विनिःश्वस्य मन्थरामिदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
evamuktā tu kaikeyī kopena jvalitānanā |
dīrghamuśhṭam viniḥśvasya mantharāmidam abravīt
verses.translation: After hearing those words, Kaikeyi with her face burning with anger, had a long and hot sigh and spoke to Manthara as follows:

verses.devanagari:
अद्य राममितः क्षिप्रं वनं प्रस्थापयाम्यहम् |
यौवराज्ये च भरतं क्षिप्रमेवाभिषेचये
verses.iast:
adya rāmamitaḥ kśipraṃ vanaṃ prasthāpayāmyaham |
yauvarājye ca bharataṃ kśipramevābhiśhecaye
verses.translation: "Now itself, I shall send Rama quickly to forest. I shall get Bharata anointed for princely kingdom immediately."

glosses.meaning: I shall also get Bharata anointed

verses.devanagari:
इदं त्विदानीं संपश्य केनोपायेन मन्थरे |
भरतः प्राप्नुयाद्राज्यं न तु रामः कथंचन
verses.iast:
idaṃ tvidānīṃ sampaśya kenopāyena manthare |
bharataḥ prāpnuyādrājyaṃ na tu rāmaḥ kathañcana
verses.translation: "O Manthara! What is the means by which Bharata will get the kingdom but Rama will not get it by any method. Think about it now."

glosses.meaning: O Manthara! kena upaayena = what is the means by which

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्ता तया देव्या मन्थरा पापदर्शिनी |
रामार्थमुपहिंसन्ती कैकेयीमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
evamuktā tayā devyā mantharā pāpadarśinī |
rāmārthamupahiṃsantī kaikeyīmidamabravīt
verses.translation: After hearing her words, the sinful thinking Manthara, spoke thus to Kaikeyi to destroy Rama's benefit of kingdom.

verses.devanagari:
हन्तेदानीं प्रवक्ष्यामि कैकेयि श्रूयतां च मे |
यथा ते भरतो राज्यं पुत्रः प्राप्स्यति केवलम्
verses.iast:
hantedānīṃ pravakśyāmi kaikeyi śrūyatāṃ ca me |
yathā te bharato rājyaṃ putraḥ prāpsyati kevalam
verses.translation: "O Kaikeyi! I am very glad. I shall tell you the means by which your son Bharata only will get the kingdom. Listen to it!"

glosses.meaning: O Kaikeyi! hanta = (I am) very glad! pravakshhyaami = I will tell

verses.devanagari:
किं न स्मरसि कैकेयि स्मरन्ती वा निगूहसे |
यदुच्यमानमात्मार्थं मत्तस्त्वं श्रोतुमिच्छसि
verses.iast:
kiṃ na smarasi kaikeyi smarantī vā nigūhase |
yaducyamānamātmārthaṃ mattastvaṃ śrotumicchasi
verses.translation: "Oh, Kaikeyi! You desire to hear from me the means for your benefit. Have you forgotten about it or are you hiding, even if you have remembered it?"

glosses.meaning: O Kaikeyi! tvam yat ichchhati = you are desiring

verses.devanagari:
मयोच्यमानं यदि ते श्रोतुं छन्दो विलासिनि |
श्रूयतामभिधास्यामि श्रुत्वा चैतद् विधीयताम्
verses.iast:
mayocyamānaṃ yadi te śrotuṃ cchndo vilāsini |
śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi śrutvā caitad vidhīyatām
verses.translation: "O the lady of charms, Kaikeyi! If you desire to hear this from my mouth, I shall tell you. Listen to me. Let it be acted upon after listening to me."

glosses.meaning: o lady full of charms! chhandaH yadi = If it is desired
let it be acted upon also.

verses.devanagari:
श्रुत्वैवं वचनं तस्या मन्थरायास्तु कैकयि |
किंचिदुत्थाय शयनात्स्वास्तीर्णादिदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ tasyā mantharāyāstu kaikayi |
kiñcidutthāya śayanātsvāstīrṇādidamabravīt
verses.translation: After hearing Manthara's words, Kaikeyi slightly rose from the well-laid bed and spoke the following :

verses.devanagari:
कथय त्वं ममोपायं केनोपायेन मन्थरे |
भरतः प्राप्नुयाद्रज्यं न तु रामः कथंचन
verses.iast:
kathaya tvaṃ mamopāyaṃ kenopāyena manthare |
bharataḥ prāpnuyādrajyaṃ na tu rāmaḥ kathañcana
verses.translation: "O Manthara! Tell me the trick by which Bharata will get the kingdom and Rama will not get it under any circumstances."

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्ता तया देव्या मन्थरा पापदर्शिनी |
रामार्थमुपहिंसन्ती कुब्जा वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
evamuktā tayā devyā mantharā pāpadarśinī |
rāmārthamupahiṃsantī kubjā vacanamabravīt
verses.translation: After hearing Kaikeyi's words, the sinful thinking, hunch backed Manthara, spoke thus, with an intention to destroy Rama's benefit of kingdom.

verses.devanagari:
तव दैवासुरे युद्धे सहराजर्षिभिः पतिः |
अगच्छत्त्वामुपादाय देवराजस्य साह्यकृत्
दिशमास्थाय वै देवि दक्षिणां दण्डकान् प्रति |
वैजयन्तमिति क्यातं पुरं यत्र तिमिध्वजः
verses.iast:
tava daivāsure yuddhe saharājarśhibhiḥ patiḥ |
agacchattvāmupādāya devarājasya sāhyakṛt
diśamāsthāya vai devi dakśiṇāṃ daṇḍakān prati |
vaijayantamiti kyātaṃ puraṃ yatra timidhvajaḥ
verses.translation: "O Queen! Once upon a time, when there was a battle between celestials and demons, your husband Dasaratha went along with you and other holy kings to help Indra in battle, to a famous city called Vaijayata in which the demon Timidhvaja lived in a southern direction in the forest of Dandaka."

glosses.meaning: O queen! yuddhe = in a battle
between celestials and demons tava patiH = your husband

verses.devanagari:
स शम्बर इति ख्यातः शतमायो महासुरः |
ददौ शक्रस्य संग्रामं देवसङिघैरनिर्जितः
verses.iast:
sa śambara iti khyātaḥ śatamāyo mahāsuraḥ |
dadau śakrasya saṅgrāmaṃ devasaṇ^ighairanirjitaḥ
verses.translation: "That great demon famously called shambara, who had several magic effects, defeated all the celestials and conferred battle upon Devendra."

verses.devanagari:
तस्मिन् महति संग्रामे पुरुषान् क्षतविक्षतान् |
रात्रौ प्रसुप्तान् घ्नन्ति स्म तरसासाद्य राक्षसाः
verses.iast:
tasmin mahati saṅgrāme puruśhān kśatavikśatān |
rātrau prasuptān ghnanti sma tarasāsādya rākśasāḥ
verses.translation: "In that great battle, demons approached and forcefully killed men who were injured by arrows and also those who were sleeping at night."
notes: Comment : It is not a virtuous practice according to scriptures, to kill injured people and defenceless people sleeping at night. Demons do not follow such scriptures.

verses.devanagari:
तत्राकरोन्महायुद्धं राजा दशरथ स्तदा |
असुरैश्च महाबाहुः शस्त्रैश्च शकलीकृतः
verses.iast:
tatrākaronmahāyuddhaṃ rājā daśaratha stadā |
asuraiśca mahābāhuḥ śastraiśca śakalīkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: "Then, king Dasaratha fought a great battle there. With their weapons, demons made into pieces the long armed Dasaratha."

verses.devanagari:
अपवाह्य त्वया देवि संग्रामान्नष्टचेतनः |
तत्रपि विक्षतः शस्रैः पतिस्ते रक्षितस्त्वया
verses.iast:
apavāhya tvayā devi saṅgrāmānnaśhṭacetanaḥ |
tatrapi vikśataḥ śasraiḥ patiste rakśitastvayā
verses.translation: "O Queen! You saved the life of your unconscious husband by taking him away from the battle field. There also, you again saved him, when beaten by demons with their weapons."

verses.devanagari:
तुष्टेन तेन दत्तौ ते द्वौ वरौ शुभदर्शने |
सत्वयोक्तः पतिर्देवि यदेच्छेयं तदा वरौ
गृह्णीयामिति तत्तन तधेत्युक्तं महात्मना |
verses.iast:
tuśhṭena tena dattau te dvau varau śubhadarśane |
satvayoktaḥ patirdevi yadeccheyaṃ tadā varau
gṛhṇīyāmiti tattana tadhetyuktaṃ mahātmanā |
verses.translation: "O Kaikeyi with auspicious appearance! Getting delighted, he gave two boons to you. Then, you said, " I shall ask you whenever I require them". He then agreed to it."

glosses.meaning: O Kaikeyi with auspicious appearance! tushhTena = after getting delighted

verses.devanagari:
अनभिज्ञा ह्यहं देवि त्वयैव कथिता पुरा
कथैषा तव तु स्नेहान्मनसा धार्यते मया |
रामाभिषेकसंभारान्निगृह्य विनिवर्तय
verses.iast:
anabhijJṇā hyahaṃ devi tvayaiva kathitā purā
kathaiśhā tava tu snehānmanasā dhāryate mayā |
rāmābhiśhekasambhārānnigṛhya vinivartaya
verses.translation: "O Queen! I do not know what had happened there. You yourself told this story previously to me. I am keeping this in my mind because of my friendship with you. Hence, you have to stop, by force, the arrangements being made for Rama's coronation."

glosses.meaning: do not know anything about this matter

verses.devanagari:
तौ वरौ याच भर्तारं भरतस्याभिषेचनम् |
प्रव्राजनं तु रामस्य त्वं वर्षाणि चतुर्दश
verses.iast:
tau varau yāca bhartāraṃ bharatasyābhiśhecanam |
pravrājanaṃ tu rāmasya tvaṃ varśhāṇi caturdaśa
verses.translation: "You ask your husband as two boons, anointing Bharata for princely kingdom and sending Rama to exile for fourteen years."

verses.devanagari:
चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणिरामे प्रव्राजिते वनम् |
प्रजाभावगतस्नेहः स्थिरः पुत्रो भविष्यति
verses.iast:
caturdaśa hi varśhāṇirāme pravrājite vanam |
prajābhāvagatasnehaḥ sthiraḥ putro bhaviśhyati
verses.translation: If you send Rama to forest for fourteen years, your son Bharata will get intimate association in the hearts of the people and will get stabilised in kingdom.

glosses.meaning: will get intimate association in the people's hearts

verses.devanagari:
क्रोधागारं प्रविश्याद्य कृद्द्धेवाश्वपतेः सुते |
शेष्वानन्तर्हितायां त्वं भूमौ मलिनवासिनी
verses.iast:
krodhāgāraṃ praviśyādya kṛdddhevāśvapateḥ sute |
śeśhvānantarhitāyāṃ tvaṃ bhūmau malinavāsinī
verses.translation: Oh, kaikeyi! Now, enter the room of wrath as if angry with him and lie down on floor without any spread underneath and wearing soiled clothes.

glosses.itrans: Kaikeyi the daughter of Asvapati! adya
glosses.iast: Kaikeyi the daughter of Asvapati! adya
glosses.devanagari: Kऐकेयि थे दौघ्तेर् ओf Aस्वपति! अद्य

verses.devanagari:
मास्मैनं प्रत्युदीक्षेथा माचैन मभिभाषथाः |
रुदन्ती चापि तं दृष्ट्वा जगत्यां शोकलालसा
verses.iast:
māsmainaṃ pratyudīkśethā mācaina mabhibhāśhathāḥ |
rudantī cāpi taṃ dṛśhṭvā jagatyāṃ śokalālasā
verses.translation: As soon as you see Dasaratha, be sorrowful and keep on weeping, without looking at him and without talking to him face to face.

glosses.meaning: do not look face to face

verses.devanagari:
दयिता त्वं सदा भर्तुरत्र मे नास्ति संशयः |
त्वत्कृते स महाराजो विशेदपि हुताशनम्
verses.iast:
dayitā tvaṃ sadā bharturatra me nāsti saṃśayaḥ |
tvatkṛte sa mahārājo viśedapi hutāśanam
verses.translation: You are always dear to your husband. I have no doubt about it. King Dasaratha will even jump into a fire for your sake.

verses.devanagari:
न त्वां क्रोधयितुं शक्तोन क्रुद्धां प्रत्युदीक्षितुम्|
तव प्रियार्थं राजा हि प्राणानपि परित्यजेत्
verses.iast:
na tvāṃ krodhayituṃ śaktona kruddhāṃ pratyudīkśitum |
tava priyārthaṃ rājā hi prāṇānapi parityajet
verses.translation: The king is not capable of making you angry. He is not even able to see you with anger. He will give up his life for your love.

glosses.meaning: the king na shaktaH = is not capable

verses.devanagari:
न ह्यतिक्रमितुं शक्तस्तव वाक्यं महीपतिः |
मन्दस्वभावे बुद्ध्यस्व सौभाग्यबलमात्मनः
verses.iast:
na hyatikramituṃ śaktastava vākyaṃ mahīpatiḥ |
mandasvabhāve buddhyasva saubhāgyabalamātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Oh, foolish one! The king will not be able to transgress your word. You realise your abundant strength.

verses.devanagari:
मणिमुक्तं सुवर्णानि रत्नानि विविधानि च |
दद्याद्धशरथो राजा मा स्म तेषु मनः कृथाः
verses.iast:
maṇimuktaṃ suvarṇāni ratnāni vividhāni ca |
dadyāddhaśaratho rājā mā sma teśhu manaḥ kṛthāḥ
verses.translation: King Dasaratha may offer you diamonds, pearls, gold and various other precious stones. Do not care for them.

verses.devanagari:
यौ तौ दैवासुरे युद्धे वरौ द्शरथोऽददात् |
तौ स्मारय महाभागे सोऽर्थो मात्वामतिक्रमेत्
verses.iast:
yau tau daivāsure yuddhe varau dśaratho'dadāt |
tau smāraya mahābhāge so'rtho mātvāmatikramet
verses.translation: Oh, Kaikeyi, the great fortunate! you remind Dasaratha of those boons given by him to you in that battle between celestials and demons. See that your benefit does not get thwarted.

verses.devanagari:
यदा तु ते वरं दद्यात्स्वयमुत्थाप्य राघवः |
व्यवस्थाप्य महाराजं तमिमं वृणुया वरम्
verses.iast:
yadā tu te varaṃ dadyātsvayamutthāpya rāghavaḥ |
vyavasthāpya mahārājaṃ tamimaṃ vṛṇuyā varam
verses.translation: Dasaratha himself will raise you from the floor and offer you the boon. Thus , after making him steady, you ask for this boon.

glosses.meaning: will raise you from the floor

verses.devanagari:
रामं प्रव्राजयारण्ये नव वर्षाणि पञ्च च |
भरतः क्रियतां राजा पृथिव्याः पार्थिवर्षभ
verses.iast:
rāmaṃ pravrājayāraṇye nava varśhāṇi paJṇca ca |
bharataḥ kriyatāṃ rājā pṛthivyāḥ pārthivarśhabha
verses.translation: "Oh, king! send Rama to forest for fourteen years. Let Bharata be made as king of this earth".

verses.devanagari:
चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि रामे प्रव्राजिते वन्म् |
रूढश्च कृतमूलश्च शेषं स्थास्यति ते सुतः
verses.iast:
caturdaśa hi varśhāṇi rāme pravrājite vanm |
rūḍhaśca kṛtamūlaśca śeśhaṃ sthāsyati te sutaḥ
verses.translation: Rama having been sent to forest for fourteen years, your son will stand firmly, having laid his roots and will stay in power for the remaining period.

verses.devanagari:
रामप्रव्राजनं चैव देवि याचस्व तं वरम् |
एवं सिद्ध्यन्ति पुत्रस्य सर्वार्थास्तव भामिनि
verses.iast:
rāmapravrājanaṃ caiva devi yācasva taṃ varam |
evaṃ siddhyanti putrasya sarvārthāstava bhāmini
verses.translation: Oh, Kaikeyi! Ask Dasaratha of sending Rama to forest also as a boon. Thus, your son will accomplish all the desired benefits.

glosses.meaning: of sending Rama to forest also

verses.devanagari:
एवं प्रव्राजितश्चैव रामोऽरामो भविष्यति |
भरतश्च हतामित्रस्तव राजा भविष्यति
verses.iast:
evaṃ pravrājitaścaiva rāmo'rāmo bhaviśhyati |
bharataśca hatāmitrastava rājā bhaviśhyati
verses.translation: Thus , by sending Rama to exile, he will not become amiable to people. Your Bharata will become king, after the enemies having been annihilated.

verses.devanagari:
येन कालेन रामश्च वनात्प्रत्यागमिष्यति |
तेन कालेन पुत्रस्ते कृतमूलो भविष्यति
सुगृहीतमनुष्यश्च सुहृद्भिः सार्धमात्मवान् |
verses.iast:
yena kālena rāmaśca vanātpratyāgamiśhyati |
tena kālena putraste kṛtamūlo bhaviśhyati
sugṛhītamanuśhyaśca suhṛdbhiḥ sārdhamātmavān |
verses.translation: When Rama returns from forest, your wise son will accumulate friends and draw people to his fold, thus establishing roots himself.

glosses.meaning: having drawn people to his fold
one by whom roots are established.

verses.devanagari:
प्राप्तकालं नु मन्येऽहं राजानं वीतसाध्वसा
रामाभिषेकसंकल्पान्निगृह्य विनिवर्तय |
verses.iast:
prāptakālaṃ nu manye'haṃ rājānaṃ vītasādhvasā
rāmābhiśhekasaṅkalpānnigṛhya vinivartaya |
verses.translation: This is the appropriate time for you. Be fearless and by your insistence, make the king turn aside his effort to anoint Rama.

glosses.meaning: that it is the appropriate time

verses.devanagari:
अनर्थमर्थरूपेण ग्राहिता सा ततस्तया
हृष्टा प्रतीता कैकेयी मन्थरामिदमब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
anarthamartharūpeṇa grāhitā sā tatastayā
hṛśhṭā pratītā kaikeyī mantharāmidamabravīt |
verses.translation: Kaikeyi, being brain-washed an unworthy matter as the most worthy matter by Manthara, accepted her well and having delighted, spoke to her as follows:-

glosses.meaning: in the form of a worthy matter

verses.devanagari:
सा हि वाक्येन कुब्जायाः किशोरीवोत्पथं गता |
कैकेयी विस्मयं प्राप्ता परं परमदर्शना
verses.iast:
sā hi vākyena kubjāyāḥ kiśorīvotpathaṃ gatā |
kaikeyī vismayaṃ prāptā paraṃ paramadarśanā
verses.translation: Though of right thinking in nature, Kaikeyi was very much surprised to hear Manthara's words and like a small girl, got into a wrong path.

verses.devanagari:
कुब्जे त्वां नाभिजानामि श्रेष्ठां श्रेष्ठभिधायिनीम् |
पृथिव्यामसि कुब्जानामुत्तमा बुद्धिनिर्णये
verses.iast:
kubje tvāṃ nābhijānāmi śreśhṭhāṃ śreṣṭhabhidhāyinīm |
pṛthivyāmasi kubjānāmuttamā buddhinirṇaye
verses.translation: Oh, Manthara! You are telling very good things. Till now, I have not recognised you as this good. You are the best among the hunch-backed on this earth in making intellectual decisions.

verses.devanagari:
त्वमेव तु ममार्थेषु नित्ययुक्ता हितैषिणी
नाहं समवबुद्ध्येयं कुब्जे राज्ञश्चिकीर्षितम् |
verses.iast:
tvameva tu mamārtheśhu nityayuktā hitaiśhiṇī
nāhaṃ samavabuddhyeyaṃ kubje rājJṇaścikīrśhitam |
verses.translation: Oh, Manthara! you always show interest in my well being and wish for my benefit. But for you, I would not have been aware of the king's intentions.

glosses.meaning: would not have been aware of

verses.devanagari:
सन्ति दुःसंस्थिताः कुब्जा वक्राः परमदारुणाः
त्वं पद्ममिव वातेन सन्नता प्रियदर्शना |
verses.iast:
santi duḥsaṃsthitāḥ kubjā vakrāḥ paramadāruṇāḥ
tvaṃ padmamiva vātena sannatā priyadarśanā |
verses.translation: There are so many hunch backed persons in the world. Their bodily construction is very bad. They are crooked and dreadful. But you appear lovely, as a lotus flower bent by breeze.

glosses.meaning: there are kubjaaH = hunch backed persons

verses.devanagari:
उरस्तेऽभिनिविष्टं वै यावत् स्कन्धात्समुन्नतम्
अधस्ताच्चोदरं शातं सुनाभमिव लज्जितम् |
verses.iast:
uraste'bhiniviśhṭaṃ vai yāvat skandhātsamunnatam
adhastāccodaraṃ śātaṃ sunābhamiva lajjitam |
verses.translation: Your chest is appearing equally on both sides and is loftily extended unto the shoulder. Below it is the stomach with an excellent navel, which is lean as though it is shy of seeing the loftiness of chest.

verses.devanagari:
परिपूर्णं तु जघनं सुपीनौ च पयोधरौ
विमलेन्दुसमं वक्त्रमहो राजसि मन्थरे |
verses.iast:
paripūrṇaṃ tu jaghanaṃ supīnau ca payodharau
vimalendusamaṃ vaktramaho rājasi manthare |
verses.translation: Oh, Manthara! with perfect hips and well rounded breasts and with your face like an untainted moon you are shining well.

verses.devanagari:
जघनं तव निर्घुष्टं रशनादामशोभितम्
जङघे भ्^इशमुपन्यस्ते पादौ चाप्यायतावुभौ |
verses.iast:
jaghanaṃ tava nirghuśhṭaṃ raśanādāmaśobhitam
jaṇ^aghe bh^iśamupanyaste pādau cāpyāyatāvubhau |
verses.translation: Oh, Manthara! your waist decorated with golden belt is making sound. Your leg-muscles are well rounded and your feet are tall.

verses.devanagari:
त्वमायताभ्यां सक्थिभ्यां मन्थरे क्षौमवासिनी |
अग्रतो मम गच्छन्ती राजहंसेव भाससे
verses.iast:
tvamāyatābhyāṃ sakthibhyāṃ manthare kśaumavāsinī |
agrato mama gacchantī rājahaṃseva bhāsase
verses.translation: Oh, Manthara! you are splendid like a royal swan walking before me, with long thighs are wearing a silk sari.

verses.devanagari:
आसन्याः शम्बरे मायाः सहस्रमसुराधिपे
सर्वास्त्वयि निविष्टास्ता भूयश्चान्याः सहस्रशः |
verses.iast:
āsanyāḥ śambare māyāḥ sahasramasurādhipe
sarvāstvayi niviśhṭāstā bhūyaścānyāḥ sahasraśaḥ |
verses.translation: In addition to all those thousand magic effects lying in shambara, the lord of demons, another further thousands of magic effects are lying in you.

glosses.meaning: thousands of anyaashcha = others nivisTaaH = are lying

verses.devanagari:
तवेदं स्थगु यद्दीर्घं रथघोणमिवायतम्
मतयः क्षत्रविद्याश्च मायाश्चात्र वसन्ति ते |
verses.iast:
tavedaṃ sthagu yaddīrghaṃ rathaghoṇamivāyatam
matayaḥ kśatravidyāśca māyāścātra vasanti te |
verses.translation: In your long hunch, which looks like an apex of a chariot, are dwelling your various thoughts, royal arts and magic effects.

glosses.meaning: looking like long apex of a chariot

verses.devanagari:
अत्रते प्रतिमोक्ष्यामि मालां कुब्जे हिरण्मयीम्
अभिषिक्ते च भरते राघवे च वनं गते |
verses.iast:
atrate pratimokśyāmi mālāṃ kubje hiraṇmayīm
abhiśhikte ca bharate rāghave ca vanaṃ gate |
verses.translation: Oh Manthara! When Rama goes to forest and Bharata gets kingdom, I shall adore this hunch back with a golden garland.

verses.devanagari:
जात्येन च सुवर्णेन सुविष्टप्तेन मन्थरे
लब्धार्था च प्रतीता च लेपयिष्यामि ते स्थगु |
verses.iast:
jātyena ca suvarṇena suviśhṭaptena manthare
labdhārthā ca pratītā ca lepayiśhyāmi te sthagu |
verses.translation: Oh, Manthara! After accomplishing the benefit desired by me, I shall, with delight, get your hunch back anointed with well refined gold of good quality.

glosses.meaning: and having delighted lapayishhyaami = I shall anoint

verses.devanagari:
मुखे च तिलकं चित्रं जातरूपमयं शुभम्
कारयिष्यामि ते कुब्जे शुभान्यभरणानि च|
verses.iast:
mukhe ca tilakaṃ citraṃ jātarūpamayaṃ śubham
kārayiśhyāmi te kubje śubhānyabharaṇāni ca |
verses.translation: Oh, Manthara! I shall get beautiful ornaments made and for your forehead auspicious dots of variety done of pure gold.

verses.devanagari:
परिधाय शुभे वस्त्रे देवतेव चरिष्यसि
चंद्रमाह्वयमानेन मुखेनाप्रतिमानना|
गमिष्यसि गतिं मुख्यांगर्वयन्ती द्विषज्जने
verses.iast:
paridhāya śubhe vastre devateva cariśhyasi
candramāhvayamānena mukhenāpratimānanā |
gamiśhyasi gatiṃ mukhyāṅgarvayantī dviśhajjane
verses.translation: You will be moving around like an angel, wearing beautiful clothes. You will achieve an important position in the eyes of your adversaries with pride and with your face, incomparably competing with moon.

verses.devanagari:
तवापि कुब्जायाः सर्वाभरणभूषिताः |
पादौ परिचरिष्यन्ति यथैव त्वं सदा मम
verses.iast:
tavāpi kubjāyāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūśhitāḥ |
pādau paricariśhyanti yathaiva tvaṃ sadā mama
verses.translation: The hunch backed women, adorned with all ornaments, will always do service, at your feet, as how as hunch-backed women, adorned with all ornaments, will always do service at your feet, as how as hunch-backed you are doing it to me.

verses.devanagari:
इति प्रशस्यमाना सा कैकेयीमिदमब्रवीत् |
शयानां शयने शुभ्रे वेद्यामग्निशिखामिव
verses.iast:
iti praśasyamānā sā kaikeyīmidamabravīt |
śayānāṃ śayane śubhre vedyāmagniśikhāmiva
verses.translation: Manthara in this way being praised spoke these words to Kaikeyi, who was lying in a clean couch like a flame of fire upon the sacrificial altar.

glosses.meaning: to Kaikeyim shaanaam = who was lying

verses.devanagari:
गतोदके सेतुबन्दो न कल्याणि विधीयते |
उत्तिष्ठ कुरु कल्याणं राजानमसुदर्शय
verses.iast:
gatodake setubando na kalyāṇi vidhīyate |
uttiśhṭha kuru kalyāṇaṃ rājānamasudarśaya
verses.translation: Oh, Kaikeyi the auspicious one! When water has already flown out, there is no use constructing a dam. Now rise and do this purposeful action. Show your influence to the king.

glosses.meaning: in a place where water has flown out

verses.devanagari:
तथा प्रोत्साहिता देवी गता मन्थरया सह |
क्रोधागारं विशालाक्षी सौभाग्यमदगर्विता
अनेकशतसाहस्रं मुक्ताहारं वराङ्गना |
अवमुच्य वराराणि शुभान्याभरणानि च
ततो हेमोपमा तत्र कुब्जावाक्यवशंगता |
संविश्य भूमौ कैकेयी मन्थरामिदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tathā protsāhitā devī gatā mantharayā saha |
krodhāgāraṃ viśālākśī saubhāgyamadagarvitā
anekaśatasāhasraṃ muktāhāraṃ varāṇ^ganā |
avamucya varārāṇi śubhānyābharaṇāni ca
tato hemopamā tatra kubjāvākyavaśaṅgatā |
saṃviśya bhūmau kaikeyī mantharāmidamabravīt
verses.translation: By surrendering to the words of Manthara and having been thus encouraged by her, Kaikeyi who was of wide eyes, who was proud of her intoxicating beauty, who was a gifted woman and a queen, removed pearl necklace worth in lacs and other great valuable auspicious ornaments from her body, entered the chamber of wrath along with Manthara, lied on the floor there like a golden wire and spoke to Manthara as follows:

glosses.meaning: by surrendering to the words of the hunch backed Manthara
who was proud of intoxicating beauty
worth in lacs varaarhaNi = greatly valued

verses.devanagari:
इह वा मां मृतां कुब्जे णृपायावेदयिष्यसि |
वनं तु राघवे प्राप्तेभरतः प्राप्स्यति क्षितिम्
verses.iast:
iha vā māṃ mṛtāṃ kubje ṇṛpāyāvedayiśhyasi |
vanaṃ tu rāghave prāptebharataḥ prāpsyati kśitim
verses.translation: "After Rama's going to the forest, Bharata shall get the kingdom. Or else, you inform the king that I died here itself".

verses.devanagari:
न सुवर्णेन मे ह्यर्थो न रत्नैर्न च भूषणैः |
एष मे जीवितस्यान्तो रामो यद्यभिषिच्यते
verses.iast:
na suvarṇena me hyartho na ratnairna ca bhūśhaṇaiḥ |
eśha me jīvitasyānto rāmo yadyabhiśhicyate
verses.translation: Neither gold nor diamonds nor ornaments are of any use to me. on which day Rama gets anointed for the kingdom, the same day it will be the end of my life.

glosses.meaning: If Rama gets anointed for kingdom

verses.devanagari:
अथो पुनस्तां महिषीं महीक्षितो |
वचोभिरत्यर्थ महापराक्रमैः |
उवाच कुब्जा भरतस्य मातरं |
हितं वचो राममुपेत्य चाहितम्
verses.iast:
atho punastāṃ mahiśhīṃ mahīkśito |
vacobhiratyartha mahāparākramaiḥ |
uvāca kubjā bharatasya mātaraṃ |
hitaṃ vaco rāmamupetya cāhitam
verses.translation: Afterwards, that Manthara again spoke to the seriously talking mother of Bharata that is Kaikeyi the following words which were beneficial to her and not beneficial in relation to Rama.

verses.devanagari:
प्रपत्स्यते राज्यमिदं हि राघवो |
यदि ध्रुवं त्वं स सुता च तप्स्यसे |
अतो हि कल्याणि यतस्व तत्तथा |
यथा सुतस्ते भरतोऽभिषेक्ष्यते
verses.iast:
prapatsyate rājyamidaṃ hi rāghavo |
yadi dhruvaṃ tvaṃ sa sutā ca tapsyase |
ato hi kalyāṇi yatasva tattathā |
yathā sutaste bharato'bhiśhekśyate
verses.translation: If Rama becomes king, you and your son will be destroyed. Oh, Kaikeyi of auspicious qualities! Hence you try for coronation of your son, Bharata

verses.devanagari:
तथातिविद्धा महिषि तु कुब्जया |
समाहता वागिषुभिर्मुहुर्मुहुः |
विधाय हस्तौ हृदयेऽतिविस्मिता |
श्शंस कुब्जां कुपिता पुनः पुनः
verses.iast:
tathātividdhā mahiśhi tu kubjayā |
samāhatā vāgiśhubhirmuhurmuhuḥ |
vidhāya hastau hṛdaye'tivismitā |
śśaṃsa kubjāṃ kupitā punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Having thus hit by arrows of words employed by Manthara again and again, Kaikeyi felt sad, was angry with the king, by keeping hands on her heart, was surprised with the cleverness of Manthara and praised her time and again.

verses.devanagari:
यमस्य वा मां विषयं गतामितो |
निशाम्य कुब्जे प्रतिवेदयिष्यसि |
वनं गते वा सुचिराय राघवे |
समृद्धकामो भरतो भविष्यति
verses.iast:
yamasya vā māṃ viśhayaṃ gatāmito |
niśāmya kubje prativedayiśhyasi |
vanaṃ gate vā sucirāya rāghave |
samṛddhakāmo bharato bhaviśhyati
verses.translation: If Rama does not go to forest from here, I do not long for any mattresses or garlands or sandal paste or eye-liner or drink or food or even the loaf here.

verses.devanagari:
अहं हि वै नास्तरणानि न स्रजो |
न चन्दनं नाञ्जनपानभोजनम् |
न किंचिदिच्छामि न चेह जीवितं |
न चेदितो गच्छति राघवो वनम्
verses.iast:
ahaṃ hi vai nāstaraṇāni na srajo |
na candanaṃ nāJṇjanapānabhojanam |
na kiñcidicchāmi na ceha jīvitaṃ |
na cedito gacchati rāghavo vanam
verses.translation: If Rama does not go to forest from here, I do not long for any mattresses or garlands or sandal paste or eye-liner or drink or food or even the life here.

glosses.meaning: If Rama does not go to forest

verses.devanagari:
अथैतदुक्त्वा वचनं सुदारुणं |
न्धाय सर्वाभरणानि भामिनी |
असंवृतामास्तरणेन मेदिनीं |
तदाधिशिश्ये पतितेव किन्नरी
verses.iast:
athaitaduktvā vacanaṃ sudāruṇaṃ |
ndhāya sarvābharaṇāni bhāminī |
asaṃvṛtāmāstaraṇena medinīṃ |
tadādhiśiśye patiteva kinnarī
verses.translation: Kaikeyi, thus uttering cruel words, having removed all ornaments, lied on the floor without a mattress like a fallen angel.

glosses.meaning: removing and keeping at one place
like a fallen angel called kinnara.

verses.devanagari:
उदीर्णसंरम्भतमोवृतानना |
तदावमुक्तोत्तममूल्यभूषणा |
नरेन्द्रपत्नी विमना बभूव सा |
तमोवृता द्यौरिव मग्नतारका
verses.iast:
udīrṇasaṃrambhatamovṛtānanā |
tadāvamuktottamamūlyabhūśhaṇā |
narendrapatnī vimanā babhūva sā |
tamovṛtā dyauriva magnatārakā
verses.translation: Kaikeyi, having removed all adornments, having her face covered by the darkness of extreme anger and with her depressed mind, looked like a starless sky in a gloomy night.

glosses.meaning: having her face covered by the darkness of extreme anger
